name: counterexample-check
label: Exact counterexample check
description: Recomputes an integer expression at n with exact arithmetic and checks a predicate. Exit 0 = predicate HOLDS = the exact counterexample is confirmed, target claim is falsified. Use for claims of the form 'for all n, P(f(n))' when you found a specific n breaking P.

inputs.name: expression
inputs.description: integer arithmetic over n, e.g. n*n+n+41

inputs.name: n
inputs.description: integer value of n to test
